title: A Quiet Beginning
description: You wake in a small village with nothing but your wits and a faint resonance of spiritual energy.

title: Market Discovery
description: The market bustles. A mysterious peddler eyes you.

title: Old Shrine
description: An old shrine hums with leftover spiritual energy.

title: Strange Trinket
description: The trinket glows; you feel a spark of affinity.

title: Helpful Stranger
description: A wandering cultivator offers to teach you a simple breathing technique.

title: Inner Resonance
description: You feel a small awakening in your meridians.

title: Trinket Study
description: You glean a minor skill from the trinket.

title: Easy Money
description: You sell the trinket to a collector.

title: Breath Technique
description: The breathing technique helps you gather Qi faster.

title: Morning Training
description: You train; your body tightens and Qi becomes more responsive.

title: Consolidation
description: You consolidate your gains. Minor increase in lifespan.

title: Skill Demo
description: You successfully use the minor skill in practice.

title: Supplies Bought
description: Supplies help sustain longer training sessions.

title: Dedicated Practice
description: Weeks pass as you practice. Your cultivation stage improves slightly.

title: First Rival
description: A peer challenges you; victory grants reputation.

title: Breakthrough Attempt
description: You attempt a small breakthrough. Outcome depends on preparation.

title: Steady Progress
description: Consistent work pays off, small gains in technique and Qi.

title: Old Manual
description: An old manual teaches a niche technique.

title: Rival Outcome
description: If you won, reputational boosts follow; if not, lessons learned.

title: Breakthrough Success
description: You successfully break through, feeling a surge of power.

title: Breakthrough Failure
description: The attempt fails and causes backlash; you must recover.

title: Informant
description: An informant knows of hidden trials nearby.

title: Trial Entrance
description: A small sect trial offers a rite of passage.

title: Trial Phase 1
description: Phase 1 tests agility and spirit.

title: Trial Reward
description: The trial grants insight and a small relic.

title: Relic Discovery
description: A relic holds a latent cultivation secret.

choices.text: Sell it for a large sum

title: Attunement
description: Attuning grants a powerful but unstable skill.

title: Mastery Path
description: A long road of refinement leads to true mastery.

title: Revenge Quest
description: A side quest pursuing your rival for personal story beats.

title: Rival Finale
description: A climactic duel with your rival. Outcome affects your narrative.

title: Open Horizons
description: Your sandbox journey branches into many possible explorations (trials, sects, isolated hermitages, merchant networks).

title: World Explore
description: You walk into unknown lands with countless possibilities.

title: Meet a Sage
description: A sage offers cryptic guidance and a choice of mentorship.

title: Mentor Path
description: A mentor offers a personalized storyline and specialized techniques.

title: Ruins Trek
description: Ruins contain lost artifacts and dangerous spirits.

title: Ruins Deep
description: Deep inside, a world-altering secret awaits.

title: Epic Hook
description: A plot seed for late-game epic arcs; could be used to spawn cross-world uniques or sect wars.
